subject.title: When calling a VLLM model, the usage page statistics show no data. How can I calculate usage and cost when using VLLM?

question: Should this vLLM Usage-page report stay open as an evidence-collection ticket, or should maintainers fold any cost-only remainder into https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/90674 after the reporter provides token-vs-cost proof?
rationale: Current source shows the intended vLLM token-capture and Usage-page aggregation paths, but the report lacks the artifacts needed to distinguish a remaining bug from missing local pricing or the already-open unknown-pricing product decision.

options.title: Keep for targeted evidence
options.body: Ask for a current-main or latest-release vLLM run with raw stream, transcript, Usage API payloads, screenshot, and pricing config before any code change.

options.title: Fold cost-only into pricing issue
options.body: If the reporter confirms tokens are present and only cost is missing or zero, treat the remaining work as part of https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/90674.

options.title: Close as support after docs check
options.body: If maintainers decide the current docs and local `cost` config fully answer the report, close with the provider docs and invite a new artifact-backed bug.

recommendation.title: Keep for targeted evidence
recommendation.body: Ask for a current-main or latest-release vLLM run with raw stream, transcript, Usage API payloads, screenshot, and pricing config before any code change.

likelyOwner.reason: Most connected to both the vLLM streaming-usage fix and the pricing/missing-cost contract history.
